title: Exact functors carry exact couples and their spectral sequences
statement:
Let $\Phi:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be an exact additive functor between abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], and let $C=(D,E,\alpha,f,g)$ be an exact couple in $\mathcal A$ [def-sp-exact-couple], with iterated couples $C_r=(D_r,E_r,\alpha_r,f_r,g_r)$, $C_2=C$, $C_{r+1}=C_r'$, and spectral sequence $(E_r,d_r)_{r\geq2}$, $d_r=g_r\circ f_r$. Write $\Phi C=(\Phi D,\Phi E,\Phi\alpha,\Phi f,\Phi g)$ for the datum obtained by applying $\Phi$ to every component $D^{p,q}$, $E^{p,q}$ and every structure map. Then:

1. $\Phi C$ is an exact couple in $\mathcal B$.
2. Write $(\Phi C)_r=((\Phi D)_r,(\Phi E)_r,\dots)$ for its iterated couples and $d_r^\Phi$ for its differentials. For every $r\geq2$, $(\Phi D)_r^{p,q}=\Phi(D_r^{p,q})$ as subobjects of $\Phi D^{p,q}$ (via the monomorphism $\Phi(D_r^{p,q}\hookrightarrow D^{p,q})$), and there are isomorphisms $\phi_r^{p,q}:\Phi(E_r^{p,q})\xrightarrow{\sim}(\Phi E)_r^{p,q}$ with $\phi_2=\mathrm{id}$, such that (identity on $D$-terms, $\phi_r$ on $E$-terms) is an isomorphism of exact couples $\Phi(C_r)\to(\Phi C)_r$; in particular $\phi_r\circ\Phi(d_r)=d_r^\Phi\circ\phi_r$, and $\phi_{r+1}$ is the map induced by $\phi_r$ on cohomology composed with the comparison $\Phi(\ker d_r/\operatorname{im}d_r)\cong\ker\Phi(d_r)/\operatorname{im}\Phi(d_r)$ of the exact functor $\Phi$.
3. Suppose $C$ satisfies the hypotheses of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence] for an integer $a$: $D^{p,q}=0$ for $q<a$, and $E^{p,q}=0$ unless $p\geq0$ and $q\geq a$. Then so does $\Phi C$, for the same $a$. Put $A^n=D^{0,n}$ and $F^pA^n=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^p:D^{p,n-p}\to A^n)$ for $p\geq0$, $F^pA^n=A^n$ for $p\leq0$, the finite filtration [def-sp-filtration] of that theorem; then the abutment of $\Phi C$ is $(\Phi D)^{0,n}=\Phi A^n$ and its filtration is $F^p\Phi A^n=\Phi(F^pA^n)$ as subobjects of $\Phi A^n$, so that $\kappa:\Phi(\operatorname{gr}^pA^n)\cong\operatorname{gr}^p\Phi A^n$ by exactness. For $r>\max(q-a+1,p)$ the isomorphism $\phi_r^{p,q}$ is compatible with the identifications $E_r^{p,q}=E_{r+1}^{p,q}$ and $(\Phi E)_r^{p,q}=(\Phi E)_{r+1}^{p,q}$ of that theorem, hence defines $\phi_\infty^{p,q}:\Phi(E_\infty^{p,q})\cong(\Phi E)_\infty^{p,q}$ [def-sp-convergence]. Finally, for $n=p+q$ and $r\geq\max(p+3,q-a+2)$, put $u=p-r+2$, $v=q+r-2$, let $\lambda_w=\alpha^{-w}:A^n=D^{0,n}\to D^{w,n-w}$ ($w\leq0$), an isomorphism, and let $\psi_r^{p,q}:\operatorname{gr}^pA^n\xrightarrow{\sim}E_r^{p,q}=E_\infty^{p,q}$ be the isomorphism induced by $g_r:D_r^{u,v}\to E_r^{p,q}$ through $D_r^{u,v}=\lambda_u(F^pA^n)$ and $\alpha_r(D_r^{u+1,v-1})=\lambda_u(F^{p+1}A^n)$ (this is the isomorphism $E_\infty\cong\operatorname{gr}$ of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence] as Step 2 of its proof constructs it); define $\psi_r^{\Phi}$ in the same way for $\Phi C$. Then $\phi_r^{p,q}\circ\Phi(\psi_r^{p,q})=\psi_r^{\Phi,p,q}\circ\kappa$.

proof.text: Construct imageIso by PreservesImage.iso and im.mapIso on an arrow isomorphism, cyclesIso by PreservesKernel.iso and kernel.mapIso, and quotientIso by PreservesCokernel.iso and cokernel.mapIso. The inclusion and quotient equations prove all three derived-map squares by mono and epi cancellation. The incoming differential square uses transport_square for its integer indices. Iterate Comparison.next to comparisonPages. Recursively compose pageInclusion, prove monicity and its comparison square by induction. Composition of the f and g squares proves differential naturality; Comparison.ei_π supplies the next-page equation.

proof.text: Map zero objects to retain the half-plane bounds. Apply halfPlaneConvergence to both couples for their normalized alpha colimits, limiting subobjects, finite filtrations and convergence. Define normalizedColimitIso through the normalizations at D(0,n). Prove the cocone comparison by integer induction: positive steps use the cocone equations, negative steps cancel alphaDiagonal, which is invertible by alpha_iso_left from the half-plane diagonal-colimits proof. Obtain filtrationIso through imageSubobjectIso and imageIso; cancellation of the target step inclusion proves its compatibility with successive step inclusions. Apply quotientIso to obtain gradedIso and its projection equation.

For adjacent stable pages take their canonical halfPlaneConvergence witnesses. The projection equation and the stable-page isomorphism make the kernel inclusion epi. Cancel its image under the functor; the kernel-inclusion and next-page-projection equations then prove the required stable-page naturality.

1) (q + 1)) = eqToHom (hD p q) ≫ Y.alpha p q) ∧ (∀ p q : ℤ, Φ.map (X.f p q) ≫ eqToHom (hD (p + 2) (q - 1)) = eqToHom (hE p q) ≫ Y.f p q) ∧ (∀ p q : ℤ, Φ.map (X.g p q) ≫ eqToHom (hE (p + 0) (q - 0)) = eqToHom (hD p q) ≫ Y.g p q) ∧ ∃ δ : ∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), Φ.obj ((X.pageCouple r).D p q) ≅ (Y.pageCouple r).D p q, ∃ φ : ∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), Φ.obj ((X.pageCouple r).E p q) ≅ (Y.pageCouple r).E p q, ∃ iX : ∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), (X.pageCouple r).D p q ⟶ X.D p q, ∃ iY : ∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), (Y.pageCouple r).D p q ⟶ Y.D p q, (∀ p q : ℤ, δ 0 p q = eqToIso (hD p q) ∧ φ 0 p q = eqToIso (hE p q)) ∧ (∀ p q : ℤ, iX 0 p q = 𝟙 _ ∧ iY 0 p q = 𝟙 _) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), iX (r + 1) p q = (X.pageCouple r).derivedDInclusion p q ≫ iX r p q ∧ iY (r + 1) p q = (Y.pageCouple r).derivedDInclusion p q ≫ iY r p q) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), Mono (iX r p q) ∧ Mono (iY r p q) ∧ (δ r p q).hom ≫ iY r p q = Φ.map (iX r p q) ≫ eqToHom (hD p q)) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), Φ.map ((X.pageCouple r).alpha p q) ≫ (δ r (p - 1) (q + 1)).hom = (δ r p q).hom ≫ (Y.pageCouple r).alpha p q) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), Φ.map ((X.pageCouple r).f p q) ≫ (δ r (p + 2) (q - 1)).hom = (φ r p q).hom ≫ (Y.pageCouple r).f p q) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), Φ.map ((X.pageCouple r).g p q) ≫ (φ r (p + r) (q - r)).hom = (δ r p q).hom ≫ (Y.pageCouple r).g p q) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), Φ.map ((X.pageCouple r).d p q) ≫ (φ r (p + 2 + r) (q - 1 - r)).hom = (φ r p q).hom ≫ (Y.pageCouple r).d p q) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), ∃ k : Φ.obj (kernel ((X.pageCouple r).d p q)) ⟶ kernel ((Y.pageCouple r).d p q), IsIso k ∧ k ≫ kernel.ι ((Y.pageCouple r).d p q) = Φ.map (kernel.ι ((X.pageCouple r).d p q)) ≫ (φ r p q).hom ∧ Φ.map ((X.pageCouple r).derivedEProjection p q) ≫ (φ (r + 1) p q).hom = k ≫ (Y.pageCouple r).derivedEProjection p q) ∧ (∀ (a : ℤ) (_ : ∀ p q : ℤ, q < a → IsZero (X.D p q)) (_ : ∀ p q : ℤ, (p < 0 ∨ q < a) → IsZero (X.E p q)), (∀ p q : ℤ, q < a → IsZero (Y.D p q)) ∧ (∀ p q : ℤ, (p < 0 ∨ q < a) → IsZero (Y.E p q)) ∧ ∃ LX : LimitSubobjects X, ∃ LY : LimitSubobjects Y, ∃ AX : ∀ n : ℤ, AlphaColimit X n, ∃ AY : ∀ n : ℤ, AlphaColimit Y n, ∃ hAX : ∀ n : ℤ, (AX n).obj = X.D 0 n, ∃ hAY : ∀ n : ℤ, (AY n).obj = Y.D 0 n, ∃ eA : ∀ n : ℤ, Φ.obj (AX n).obj ≅ (AY n).obj, (∀ n : ℤ, (AX n).ι 0 ≫ eqToHom (hAX n) = eqToHom (by congr 1; omega)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, (AY n).ι 0 ≫ eqToHom (hAY n) = eqToHom (by congr 1; omega)) ∧ (∀ n p : ℤ, Φ.map ((AX n).ι p) ≫ (eA n).hom = eqToHom (hD p (n - p)) ≫ (AY n).ι p) ∧ (∀ n p : ℤ, p ≤ 0 → (X.imageFiltration n (AX n)).step p = ⊤ ∧ (Y.imageFiltration n (AY n)).step p = ⊤) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, (X.imageFiltration n (AX n)).IsFinite ∧ (Y.imageFiltration n (AY n)).IsFinite) ∧ X.ConvergesTo LX AX ∧ Y.ConvergesTo LY AY ∧ ∃ τ : ∀ n p : ℤ, Φ.obj ((X.imageFiltration n (AX n)).step p : C) ≅ ((Y.imageFiltration n (AY n)).step p : B), ∃ κ : ∀ n p : ℤ, Φ.obj ((X.imageFiltration n (AX n)).gradedPiece p) ≅ (Y.imageFiltration n (AY n)).gradedPiece p, (∀ n p : ℤ, (τ n p).hom ≫ ((Y.imageFiltration n (AY n)).step p).arrow = Φ.map (((X.imageFiltration n (AX n)).step p).arrow) ≫ (eA n).hom) ∧ (∀ n p : ℤ, Φ.map (cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE ((X.imageFiltration n (AX n)).step (p + 1)) ((X.imageFiltration n (AX n)).step p) ((X.imageFiltration n (AX n)).antitone_step (by omega)))) ≫ (κ n p).hom = (τ n p).hom ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE ((Y.imageFiltration n (AY n)).step (p + 1)) ((Y.imageFiltration n (AY n)).step p) ((Y.imageFiltration n (AY n)).antitone_step (by omega)))) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), (r : ℤ) + 2 > max (q - a + 1) p → ∃ sX : (X.pageCouple r).E p q ≅ (X.pageCouple (r + 1)).E p q, ∃ sY : (Y.pageCouple r).E p q ≅ (Y.pageCouple (r + 1)).E p q, kernel.ι ((X.pageCouple r).d p q) ≫ sX.hom = (X.pageCouple r).derivedEProjection p q ∧ kernel.ι ((Y.pageCouple r).d p q) ≫ sY.hom = (Y.pageCouple r).derivedEProjection p q ∧ Φ.map sX.hom ≫ (φ (r + 1) p q).hom = (φ r p q).hom ≫ sY.hom) ∧ (∃ φInfinity : ∀ p q : ℤ, Φ.obj (X.pageInfinity LX p q) ≅ Y.pageInfinity LY p q, (∀ p q : ℤ, Φ.map (X.toPageInfinity LX p q) ≫ (φInfinity p q).hom = eqToHom (hD p q) ≫ Y.toPageInfinity LY p q) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), (r : ℤ) + 2 > max (q - a + 1) p → ∃ hZX : X.cycleBoundaryTower.Z r p q = LX.Z p q, ∃ hZY : Y.cycleBoundaryTower.Z r p q = LY.Z p q, ∃ eX : (X.pageCouple r).E p q ≅ X.pageInfinity LX p q, ∃ eY : (Y.pageCouple r).E p q ≅ Y.pageInfinity LY p q, X.cycleBoundaryTower.projection r p q ≫ eX.hom = eqToHom (congrArg (fun S : Subobject (X.E p q) ↦ (S : C)) hZX) ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE (LX.B p q) (LX.Z p q) (limitBoundary_le_cycle X LX p q)) ∧ Y.cycleBoundaryTower.projection r p q ≫ eY.hom = eqToHom (congrArg (fun S : Subobject (Y.E p q) ↦ (S : B)) hZY) ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE (LY.B p q) (LY.Z p q) (limitBoundary_le_cycle Y LY p q)) ∧ Φ.map eX.hom ≫ (φInfinity p q).hom = (φ r p q).hom ≫ eY.hom) ∧ ∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ ξX : X.pageInfinity LX p q ≅ (X.imageFiltration (p + q) (AX (p + q))).gradedPiece p, ∃ ξY : Y.pageInfinity LY p q ≅ (Y.imageFiltration (p + q) (AY (p + q))).gradedPiece p, X.toPageInfinity LX p q ≫ ξX.hom = X.toGradedPiece AX p q ∧ Y.toPageInfinity LY p q ≫ ξY.hom = Y.toGradedPiece AY p q ∧ Φ.map ξX.hom ≫ (κ (p + q) p).hom = (φInfinity p q).hom ≫ ξY.hom) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), (r : ℤ) + 2 ≥ max (p + 3) (q - a + 2) → ∃ lambdaX : (AX (p + q)).obj ≅ X.D (p - r) (q + r), ∃ lambdaY : (AY (p + q)).obj ≅ Y.D (p - r) (q + r), ∃ tX : ((X.imageFiltration (p + q) (AX (p + q))).step p : C) ≅ (X.pageCouple r).D (p - r) (q + r), ∃ tY : ((Y.imageFiltration (p + q) (AY (p + q))).step p : B) ≅ (Y.pageCouple r).D (p - r) (q + r), ∃ ψX : (X.imageFiltration (p + q) (AX (p + q))).gradedPiece p ≅ (X.pageCouple r).E p q, ∃ ψY : (Y.imageFiltration (p + q) (AY (p + q))).gradedPiece p ≅ (Y.pageCouple r).E p q, lambdaX.inv = eqToHom (by congr 1; omega) ≫ (AX (p + q)).ι (p - r) ∧ lambdaY.inv = eqToHom (by congr 1; omega) ≫ (AY (p + q)).ι (p - r) ∧ tX.hom ≫ iX r (p - r) (q + r) = ((X.imageFiltration (p + q) (AX (p + q))).step p).arrow ≫ lambdaX.hom ∧ tY.hom ≫ iY r (p - r) (q + r) = ((Y.imageFiltration (p + q) (AY (p + q))).step p).arrow ≫ lambdaY.hom ∧ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE ((X.imageFiltration (p + q) (AX (p + q))).step (p + 1)) ((X.imageFiltration (p + q) (AX (p + q))).step p) ((X.imageFiltration (p + q) (AX (p + q))).antitone_step (by omega))) ≫ ψX.hom = tX.hom ≫ (X.pageCouple r).g (p - r) (q + r) ≫ eqToHom (by congr 1 <;> omega) ∧ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE ((Y.imageFiltration (p + q) (AY (p + q))).step (p + 1)) ((Y.imageFiltration (p + q) (AY (p + q))).step p) ((Y.imageFiltration (p + q) (AY (p + q))).antitone_step (by omega))) ≫ ψY.hom = tY.hom ≫ (Y.pageCouple r).g (p - r) (q + r) ≫ eqToHom (by congr 1 <;> omega) ∧ Φ.map ψX.hom ≫ (φ r p q).hom = (κ (p + q) p).hom ≫ ψY.hom))
